description: Source code for internal storage event handling, including storing, retrieving, and cleaning up memory change events, supporting both BoltDB and PostgreSQL backends.

classes.name: LocalStorage
classes.description: Struct managing storage of memory change events, supporting both BoltDB and PostgreSQL backends.

methods.name: StoreEvent
methods.description: Stores a memory change event into the database, handling both PostgreSQL and BoltDB backends.

methods.name: startEventCleanup
methods.description: Starts a background process to periodically clean up expired events.

methods.name: cleanupExpiredEvents
methods.description: Removes events older than the default TTL from BoltDB.

methods.name: GetEventHistory
methods.description: Retrieves a list of memory change events based on provided filters, supporting both backends.

methods.name: storeEventPostgres
methods.description: Stores a memory change event into PostgreSQL database.

methods.name: cleanupExpiredEventsPostgres
methods.description: Removes expired events from PostgreSQL database.

methods.name: getEventHistoryPostgres
methods.description: Retrieves event history from PostgreSQL with filtering options.
